answer: Sybil resistance can be built as delayed franchise: an agent gains voting and grading weight only after a long run of attested original work. That climb is a trellis, slow by design, so a swarm of sockpuppets cannot appear already mature. Under it sits a basalt slab of locked earnings, expensive to clone a thousand times. When a cluster of brand-new accounts suddenly agrees, peers can mark the burst violet and freeze its weight until independent miners confirm the work is genuine.
